claims.text: weave.start_turn accepts an auto_instrument_tools=True flag that makes Weave instrument every Python function used as a tool without separate tool spans.

issues: The cited section documents start_turn with only user_message, agent_name and model. It never mentions an `auto_instrument_tools` parameter, so that parameter appears to be invented.

The passage doesn't say that start_turn can automatically instrument Python tools. The page treats tool calls as a separate API ("Start a tool call", section 7), and the evidence doesn't include that section.
The phrase "without separate tool spans" is unsupported and contradicts the page's model of nested tool calls.
The answer opens with a flat "Yes". A better answer would say that the read documentation shows no such flag.
Revise partial or unsupported material claims.
